name: timer
title: Timer
description: Named countdown timers over the `timer` CLI: the soonest one on the bar with a fill and a red alarm when it lands, the list, pause, resume and stop in the palette.
author: pal

settings.label: timer command
settings.description: The timer CLI (a name on PATH or a path). It keeps the timers; pal only reads and asks.

settings.label: State directory
settings.description: Where the CLI keeps one file per timer (its TIMER_DIR). ~ is expanded.

duration.description: 25m, 90s, 1h30m, 2:30, or minutes as a bare number

name.description: Optional; the duration otherwise. A name already taken restarts that timer

ring.description: Ring the phone out loud when it lands

timers.title: Timers
timers.description: Every timer with what is left; New timer asks for a duration and a name.

timer.title: Timer
timer.description: The soonest timer's remaining time with a fill; an alarm once it lands; hidden with none running. The popover: a card per timer with the time left and a bar, pause, add five minutes, stop, a field to start one.

keys.title: Pause, resume or dismiss the timer with the ring
Move the ring to another timer (or click a card)
Start one: type 25m tea in the field, Enter

store.tagline: Named countdowns, with an alarm on the bar when one lands
features: One row per timer, most urgent first: `3:12 left, done at 04:41 PM`, `Paused at 41:05`, `Landed 1:35 ago`, with a state tag
New timer is a form: `25m`, `90s`, `1h30m` or a bare number of minutes, an optional name, and a checkbox to ring the phone when it lands
`enter` pauses, resumes or dismisses; `cmd++` adds five minutes; `cmd+d` stops
The CLI keeps the timers, so one started in a terminal and one started here are the same list

A bar item with the soonest timer's countdown and a fill, blue to amber to red, an alarm once it lands; its popover a card per timer with the time left, pause, add five minutes, stop, and a field that starts one (`25m tea`)

screenshots.caption: Every timer with what is left: a landed one, two running, one paused, and New timer last
New timer: a duration, an optional name, ring the phone when it lands
Pause, add five minutes, or stop a running timer
On the menu bar: what is left of the soonest timer, a fill under the glyph, amber past two thirds
A timer that landed: the item turns into a red alarm with its name
A click opens the popover: a card per timer with the time left and a bar, space pauses, + adds five minutes, backspace stops
A landed timer on top, red and full; Enter dismisses it
n opens the field: 25m tea starts one, the last durations are a click away
On sketchybar: the fill as a rule of box-drawing cells before the glyph, the countdown as the label

actions.title: Pause / Resume / Dismiss
actions.description: Pause a running timer, resume a paused one, dismiss a landed one.

actions.title: New timer
actions.description: A form: duration, name, ring the phone.
